headings: A vibrant floral fragrance featuring notes of lemongrass, lychee, and myrrh.

jsonld_raw.name: LYCHEE & LEMONGRASS PARFUM 100ML
jsonld_raw.description:
LYCHEE & LEMONGRASS PARFUM 100ML. Inspired by the light, scents, and unhurried rhythm of a summer in Greece. Cliffs overlooking the Aegean Sea and sun-drenched afternoons serve as the inspiration for a composition where lemongrass provides an aromatic, vibrant freshness, lychee reveals a juicy and luminous facet, and myrrh wraps the fragrance in sophisticated warmth and subtle sensuality. A radiant and contemporary fragrance that is fresh, enveloping, and naturally elegant.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Floral | Luminous, fresh, and sophisticated
